UPDATE work_item SET status = 'CLAIMED', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, claim_token = #{claimToken}, lease_deadline = DATEADD(MILLISECOND, (#{leaseMicros} / 1000), SYSUTCDATETIME()), fence_token = work_item.fence_token + 1, last_error = 'Runtime deadline exceeded', update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() FROM ifj_trigger_work_item AS work_item, ifj_instance root_instance WHERE root_instance.id = work_item.root_instance_id AND root_instance.parent_instance_id IS NULL AND work_item.trigger_id = #{triggerId} AND work_item.fence_token < 9223372036854775807 AND root_instance.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED', 'WAITING_EVENT') AND root_instance.timeout_at IS NOT NULL AND root_instance.timeout_at <= SYSUTCDATETIME() AND ( work_item.status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'SUSPENDED', 'DEAD') OR (work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.lease_deadline <= SYSUTCDATETIME()) )

UPDATE ifj_trigger_work_item work_item SET status = 'CLAIMED', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, claim_token = #{claimToken}, lease_deadline = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) + (#{leaseMicros} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')), fence_token = work_item.fence_token + 1, last_error = 'Dead work item recovery', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM ifj_instance root_instance WHERE root_instance.id = work_item.root_instance_id AND root_instance.parent_instance_id IS NULL AND work_item.trigger_id = #{triggerId} AND work_item.status = 'DEAD' AND work_item.fence_token < 9223372036854775807 AND work_item.update_time <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) - (#{orphanGraceMicros} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')) AND root_instance.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED', 'WAITING_EVENT')
